description: This PHP source file defines a class AdministrationViewThemesettings that extends SugarView, responsible for handling theme settings in the administration module of SuiteCRM. It includes methods for processing form submissions and displaying theme configuration UI, with access control for admin users.

classes.name: AdministrationViewThemesettings
classes.description: A view class for managing theme settings in the SuiteCRM administration interface, including rendering and processing form submissions for theme customization.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates the title parameters for the module, including a link to the administration index and the theme settings label.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles submission of theme settings form, including permission checks, validation of selected themes, updating configuration, and override handling.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the theme settings form, including available and disabled themes, with access control, and passes data to the Smarty template.
